sources.title: GitHub - facebookresearch/blt: Code for BLT research paper
sources.snippet: Patches are segmented dynamically based on the entropy of the next byte, allocating more compute and model capacity where there is more data complexity. The BLT architecture includes new attention mechanisms to maximize the information flow between byte and patch hidden representations and a new type of byte-sequence memory.
